title: Regular and irregular verbs
summary: Правильные глаголы образуют past simple и причастие с **-ed**, неправильные — по-своему; формы нужно знать наизусть.
ru:
## Три формы глагола
У каждого глагола есть три формы:
- **инфинитив** (work, go) — основная
- **past simple** (worked, went) — для прошедшего времени
- **past participle** (worked, gone) — для present perfect и пассива

## Правильные глаголы (regular)
Past simple и причастие — просто **-ed**, и они совпадают.
> clean → cleaned → cleaned
> live → lived → lived
> paint → painted → painted
> study → studied → studied (y → ied)
> I **cleaned** my shoes yesterday. (past simple)
> I **have cleaned** my shoes. (present perfect)
> These rooms **are cleaned** every day. (пассив)

## Неправильные глаголы (irregular)
У них свои формы, их нужно учить. Бывает два случая.

**1. Past simple и причастие одинаковые:**
| инфинитив | past simple | participle |
|---|---|---|
| make | made | made |
| buy | bought | bought |
| find | found | found |
| cut | cut | cut |

**2. Past simple и причастие разные:**
| инфинитив | past simple | participle |
|---|---|---|
| break | broke | broken |
| know | knew | known |
| begin | began | begun |
| go | went | gone |

## Примеры
> I **made** a cake yesterday. (past simple)
> I **have made** some coffee. (present perfect)
> Butter **is made** from milk. (пассив)
> Somebody **broke** this window. → Somebody **has broken** this window. → The window **was broken** last night.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I have went home.~~ → I have **gone** home. (после have нужно причастие)
- ~~She goed to school.~~ → She **went** to school. (go — неправильный)
- ~~I have wrote a letter.~~ → I have **written** a letter.

Совет: учите все три формы вместе, группами: **buy – bought – bought**, **break – broke – broken**.
en:
## Three forms of a verb
Every verb has three main forms:
- the **infinitive** (work, go)
- the **past simple** (worked, went)
- the **past participle** (worked, gone) — for the present perfect and the passive

## Regular verbs
The past simple and past participle are the same and end in **-ed**.
> clean → cleaned → cleaned
> live → lived → lived
> paint → painted → painted
> study → studied → studied
> I **cleaned** my shoes yesterday. (past simple)
> I **have cleaned** my shoes. (present perfect)
> These rooms **are cleaned** every day. (passive)

## Irregular verbs
These verbs have their own forms. You have to learn them.

**1. Past simple and past participle are the same:**
| infinitive | past simple | participle |
|---|---|---|
| make | made | made |
| buy | bought | bought |
| find | found | found |
| cut | cut | cut |

**2. Past simple and past participle are different:**
| infinitive | past simple | participle |
|---|---|---|
| break | broke | broken |
| know | knew | known |
| begin | began | begun |
| go | went | gone |

## Examples
> I **made** a cake yesterday.
> I **have made** some coffee.
> Butter **is made** from milk.
> Somebody **broke** this window. → Somebody **has broken** it. → It **was broken** last night.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I have went home.~~ → I have **gone** home.
- ~~She goed to school.~~ → She **went** to school.
- ~~I have wrote a letter.~~ → I have **written** a letter.
structure:
## Где какая форма
| Конструкция | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| past simple | V2 | I **saw** him. |
| present perfect | have / has + V3 | I **have seen** him. |
| пассив | be + V3 | He **was seen**. |

## Правописание -ed
| Правило | Пример |
|---|---|
| обычно +ed | work → worked, clean → cleaned |
| на -e: +d | live → lived, like → liked |
| согласная + y: y → ied | study → studied, try → tried |
| гласная + y: +ed | enjoy → enjoyed, play → played |
| 1 гласная + 1 согласная: удвоение | stop → stopped, plan → planned |

## Часто встречающиеся неправильные глаголы
| инфинитив | V2 | V3 |
|---|---|---|
| get | got | got |
| bring | brought | brought |
| pay | paid | paid |
| leave | left | left |
| hear | heard | heard |
| put | put | put |
| catch | caught | caught |
| understand | understood | understood |
| write | wrote | written |
| take | took | taken |
| see | saw | seen |
| eat | ate | eaten |
| do | did | done |
| come | came | come |
